compilation_rationale: Bounded 12-layer Ta2O5/SiO2 stack optimized for broadband transmission (420-700 nm) with notch filtering at 355/365 nm and 1030-1080 nm. Coherent TMM via smatrix handles thin-film interference accurately. Targets enforce strict transmittance bounds per band. Initial thicknesses set to 200 nm uniformly within the 10–400 nm feasible range; optimizer explores full space across four independent runs. Manufacturing constraint (20–350 nm) noted but optimization uses declared 10–400 nm bounds.
